findings.problem: fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap() — unwrap() on I/O Result panics on missing/unreadable file
findings.failure_mode: untrusted or missing file path aborts the entire program instead of returning a typed error
findings.fix: return Result<Vec<Record>, io::Error> or a domain error type; propagate with ? instead of unwrap

findings.problem: parts[1].parse::<u32>().unwrap() — unwrap() on parse Result panics on invalid integer input
findings.failure_mode: malformed CSV row (non-numeric second field) crashes the process instead of yielding a typed parse error
findings.fix: use .parse::<u16>().map_err(...) and return Result; never unwrap parse on untrusted input

findings.problem: parts[1] — unchecked indexed access into Vec<String> without bounds check; line may have fewer than 2 fields
findings.failure_mode: index-out-of-panic on short lines (e.g., a line with only one comma-separated field)
findings.fix: use split_once(',') to extract first and second fields; match on the second Option and map_err on None

findings.problem: parts[0] — unchecked indexed access into Vec<String>
findings.fix: use split_once(',') and pattern-match; empty lines should be skipped or returned as errors

findings.problem: split(',') + collect + indexing instead of split_once for two-field CSV
findings.failure_mode: allocates a Vec<String> for every line; split_once avoids allocation and is the prescribed pattern

findings.problem: as u16 — lossy cast from u32 to u16; values > 65535 silently truncate
findings.failure_mode: silent data corruption: a parse of "99999" as u32 then as u16 yields 34465, not an error
findings.fix: parse directly as u16 via .parse::<u16>() and reject overflow via Result; remove the `as u16` cast

findings.problem: Function signature returns Vec<Record> with no error type; all fallible operations (I/O, parse, indexing) are forced into panic path
findings.failure_mode: caller cannot distinguish I/O errors, parse errors, or malformed lines — everything collapses to panic
findings.fix: signature should be fn load_routes(path: &str) -> Result<Vec<Record>, LoadError> where LoadError is a domain enum covering Io, Parse, and ShortLine

findings.problem: println!("loaded {}", parts[0]) — logging side effect in a data-loading function
findings.failure_mode: impure function cannot be tested deterministically; log output is uncontrolled and not part of any error contract
findings.fix: remove println!; if observability is needed, return a separate log/warning type or accept a callback

findings.problem: Missing benchmark evidence — no microbenchmark for load_routes allocation and throughput
findings.failure_mode: unknown if per-line Vec allocation and String::to_string are acceptable cost for the workload
findings.fix: add a criterion or test::Bencher benchmark measuring lines-per-second and bytes-allocated-per-ops
